title: Phone confirms a send with a sound, and Genlock notifications buzz with their own pattern and sound

requirements.text: Saying 'send' or tapping send plays an audio cue at once, so TJ knows in the car that it heard him and is sending; Genlock notifications vibrate with a pattern unique to the app, and play a distinct notification sound where the phone allows
requirements.check: On the phone: say send, hear the cue before the message goes; trigger a Genlock notification and feel the custom pattern and hear the custom sound
